title: WitCert: Sound Runtime Risk Observability and Gating for KV-Cache Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2607.28699v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: KV-cache quantization is validated today by offline benchmark averages; a deployed system cannot tell whether compression is damaging the request it is serving right now. We give it a provably sound runtime meter -- a "DTrace for KV quantization": a per-(layer, head, step) upper bound on the total variation between exact and compressed attention. The meter has two tiers: a deterministic band-norm-witness bound, sound for any cache-preserving black-box quantizer and for any query (adaptive-safe, worst-case Cauchy--Schwarz plus RoPE band-unitarity), and a tighter probabilistic certificate for a controlled subtractively-dithered INT8 quantizer under an explicit request-level failure budget (stated for non-adaptive queries; core theorems machine-checked in Lean 4). Three results. Observability: the meter enters SGLang through an env-guarded patch, and any scheme registered as one tensor function is measured in live serving. Repair:

translated_title: WitCert：KV缓存量化的声音运行时风险可观测性与门控
translated_abstract: 摘要：KV缓存量化目前通过离线基准平均值进行验证；部署系统无法判断压缩是否正在损害其当前服务的请求。我们为其提供了一个可证明声音的运行时仪表——一个“KV量化的DTrace”：对每层、每头、每步的精确与压缩注意力之间总变差的上界。该仪表有两级：确定性带范数见证上界，对任何保持缓存的任意黑盒量化器和任何查询（自适应安全，最坏情况柯西-施瓦茨加RoPE带酉性）均有效，以及一个针对受控减法抖动INT8量化器在显式请求级故障预算下的更紧的概率证书（针对非自适应查询陈述；核心定理在Lean 4中机器检查）。三个结果。可观测性：仪表通过环境守护补丁进入SGLang，任何注册为一个张量函数的方案都在实时服务中测量。修复：
tldr: 本论文提出一种可证明声音的运行时仪表，用于实时监测KV缓存量化对注意力输出的影响，并提供确定性及概率性上界，实现可观测性与门控修复。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a provably sound runtime meter for KV-cache quantization, offering deterministic and probabilistic bounds to enable observability and gating in live serving.
